about: Anonymised real SR game, one snapshot per ~90 s. `expected` was produced by the model repo's code at sync time; tests/test_golden.py re-scores it with the vendored copy. The model and item prices it was scored with are frozen next to it (golden_model.json, ddragon/), so shipping a different built-in model doesn't touch this test. Regenerate with tools/sync_core.py.
